references.title: Referenced {count, plural, one {# time slice} other {# time slices}}

loadingTips: Your conversations are saved as time slices — a slice closes 30 minutes after it starts and the next one begins
The agent works after you're done — not always-on, but results are waiting when you return
Every slice is a plain Markdown file — human-readable, git-diffable, no proprietary format
GitHub is the only database — your memory lives in your own repo, no external storage
All conversation history under memory/episodic/slices/ — organized by year, month, day, minute
Strands are keywords threading through slices — follow a topic from 2022 to today in one search
previously.md is what the agent knows about you — re-centered at each time-slice boundary as it learns
agent.md is the agent's reflection diary — it logs its own thinking and tool use, then learns from past patterns
Your agent's understanding of you self-corrects over time — it observes, reinforces, contradicts, or discards impressions
Behind every reply, slice metadata refreshes silently — focus, tags, emotional tone, open loops all stay current
Tool calls appear inline as they happen — expand any card to see what the agent is doing under the hood
The reasoning block shows the model's internal monologue — look for the brain icon in each reply
The recall tool returns original conversation content — not summaries, the real words you said
Background loops run after you close the tab — progress checkpoints back to your repo
Your agent can search the live web — results woven into the reply with source links
Demo mode uses pre-seeded personas — connect your own GitHub repo to unlock persistent memory, settings, and background loops
